ValidationRule.description: Makes Boil Water Advisory mandatory when Sample Type is Drinking Water or Drinking Water Sample.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $RecordType.DeveloperName = "PHOCSWaterLabTestRequisition", OR( ISPICKVAL(SampleType__c, "Drinking Water"), ISPICKVAL(SampleType__c, "Drinking Water Sample") ), ISPICKVAL(BoilAdvisory__c, "") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Select a value for Boil Water Advisory when the Sample Type is Drinking water
